name: Vehicle compute
caption: Figure 4 · (a) Overall task duration (ms); (b) task execution duration (ms); (c) decision computation runtime (seconds, log scale). Vehicle capacity: 13–17 TFLOPS.
insight: POPT minimizes the execution-only component, but its centralized request overhead and periodic decision points increase overall task duration. TODORA has the lowest overall duration in the reported sweep.

name: Vehicle density
caption: Figure 8 · (a) Overall task duration (ms); (b) task execution duration (ms); (c) decision computation runtime (seconds, log scale). Vehicle density: 1,500–3,500 vehicles/day.
insight: Growing vehicle density increases contention for compute and uplink airtime. TODORA maintains lower overall duration in the reported sweep, while the POPT decision runtime grows with the optimization problem size.

name: Partial offloading
caption: Figure 16 · Overall task duration (ms) versus vehicle density. Solid lines: binary offloading; dotted lines: partial offloading.
insight: Partial execution across the vehicle, edge, and cloud lowers task duration in the reported comparison. TODORAP includes splitting and result-synthesis overhead; the paper reports 0.9 ms for that overhead on the Threadripper server.
